allow: Bash(sqlite3 -header -column live.sqlite "SELECT MIN\(left\) mnl, MAX\(right\) mxr, MIN\(top\) mnt, MAX\(bottom\) mxb, MIN\(right-left\) mnw, MAX\(right-left\) mxw, MIN\(bottom-top\) mnh, MAX\(bottom-top\) mxh FROM face_embeddings;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column live.sqlite "SELECT f.person_id, f.asset_id, f.left, f.top, f.right, f.bottom, \(f.right-f.left\) w, \(f.bottom-f.top\) h FROM face_embeddings f JOIN \(SELECT person_id, MAX\(id\) mid FROM face_embeddings GROUP BY person_id\) x ON f.id=x.mid ORDER BY f.person_id LIMIT 15;")
Bash(sqlite3 live.sqlite "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM persons p WHERE NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM face_embeddings f WHERE f.person_id=p.id\);")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column live.sqlite "SELECT cnt, COUNT\(*\) persons FROM \(SELECT person_id, COUNT\(*\) cnt FROM face_embeddings GROUP BY person_id\) GROUP BY cnt ORDER BY cnt;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column live.sqlite "SELECT asset_id, MAX\(right\) max_r, MAX\(bottom\) max_b, COUNT\(*\) faces FROM face_embeddings GROUP BY asset_id HAVING max_r>512 OR max_b>512 ORDER BY max_r DESC LIMIT 20;")
Bash(sqlite3 live.sqlite "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM \(SELECT asset_id FROM face_embeddings GROUP BY asset_id HAVING MAX\(right\)>512 OR MAX\(bottom\)>512\);")
Bash(sqlite3 live.sqlite "SELECT COUNT\(DISTINCT asset_id\) FROM face_embeddings;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column p.sqlite "SELECT ROUND\(MIN\(left\),4\) mnl, ROUND\(MAX\(right\),4\) mxr, ROUND\(MIN\(top\),4\) mnt, ROUND\(MAX\(bottom\),4\) mxb, ROUND\(MIN\(right-left\),4\) mnw, ROUND\(MAX\(right-left\),4\) mxw FROM face_embeddings;")
Bash(sqlite3 p.sqlite "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM face_embeddings WHERE left<0 OR top<0 OR right>1.0001 OR bottom>1.0001;")
Bash(sqlite3 p.sqlite "SELECT ROUND\(MIN\(MIN\(right-left, bottom-top\)\),4\) FROM face_embeddings;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column p.sqlite "SELECT cnt, COUNT\(*\) persons FROM \(SELECT person_id, COUNT\(*\) cnt FROM face_embeddings GROUP BY person_id\) GROUP BY cnt ORDER BY cnt;")
Bash(sqlite3 p.sqlite "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM persons p WHERE EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM face_embeddings f WHERE f.person_id=p.id AND f.asset_id=p.cover_asset_id\);")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column db.sqlite "SELECT count\(*\) faces, count\(distinct person_id\) persons FROM face_embeddings;" "SELECT p.id, p.display_name, count\(f.id\) n FROM persons p LEFT JOIN face_embeddings f ON f.person_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY n DESC;" ".schema face_embeddings" ".schema persons")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column db.sqlite "SELECT * FROM app_settings;" "SELECT count\(*\) assets, sum\(indexed_at IS NOT NULL\) indexed FROM photo_assets;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column db.sqlite "SELECT id, person_id, round\(right-left,3\) w, round\(bottom-top,3\) h, round\(\(right-left\)/\(bottom-top\),2\) ar FROM face_embeddings ORDER BY id LIMIT 15;" "SELECT round\(avg\(\(right-left\)/\(bottom-top\)\),3\) mean_ar, min\(round\(\(right-left\)/\(bottom-top\),2\)\) minar, max\(round\(\(right-left\)/\(bottom-top\),2\)\) maxar FROM face_embeddings;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column db.sqlite ".schema photo_assets" "SELECT CASE WHEN a.width>a.height THEN 'landscape' ELSE 'portrait' END o, count\(*\) n, round\(avg\(\(\(f.right-f.left\)*a.width\)/\(\(f.bottom-f.top\)*a.height\)\),3\) mean_px_ar, round\(min\(\(\(f.right-f.left\)*a.width\)/\(\(f.bottom-f.top\)*a.height\)\),2\) mn, round\(max\(\(\(f.right-f.left\)*a.width\)/\(\(f.bottom-f.top\)*a.height\)\),2\) mx FROM face_embeddings f JOIN photo_assets a ON a.asset_id=f.asset_id GROUP BY o;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column db.sqlite "SELECT f.id, f.asset_id, a.width, a.height, round\(f.left,3\) l, round\(f.top,3\) t, round\(f.right,3\) r, round\(f.bottom,3\) b, round\(\(\(f.right-f.left\)*a.width\)/\(\(f.bottom-f.top\)*a.height\),2\) px_ar FROM face_embeddings f JOIN photo_assets a ON a.asset_id=f.asset_id WHERE a.width>a.height ORDER BY px_ar DESC LIMIT 5;" "SELECT f.id, f.asset_id, a.width, a.height, round\(f.left,3\) l, round\(f.top,3\) t, round\(f.right,3\) r, round\(f.bottom,3\) b, round\(\(\(f.right-f.left\)*a.width\)/\(\(f.bottom-f.top\)*a.height\),2\) px_ar FROM face_embeddings f JOIN photo_assets a ON a.asset_id=f.asset_id WHERE a.width<a.height ORDER BY px_ar DESC LIMIT 3;")
Bash(sqlite3 db.sqlite "SELECT id,left,top,right,bottom FROM face_embeddings WHERE asset_id='1000004169';")
